final_message:
The discrepancy report is finished and passes validation. It flags 63 items across 13 categories (11 Critical, 14 High, 17 Medium, 21 Low), and most of the money changes favor Respondent: about $30,000 in property, the Home Depot debt dropped, child support cut by $100 a month, the medical split reversed, and alimony made modifiable. It recommends that Ms. Holloway not sign the draft, that we object in writing with a conforming redraft, and that we move to enter judgment on the settlement agreement at the April 3, 2025 prove-up.
